what: More than a dozen Unitree H1 humanoids in floral vests danced the yangko alongside human dancers on China's CCTV Spring Festival Gala, spinning red handkerchiefs, in a segment made with director Zhang Yimou.
quip: Years of robotics research, delivered as a handkerchief spin.

title: Robot vacuum with an arm
what: At CES, Roborock showed the Saros Z70, a robot vacuum with a folding five-axis arm that picks up socks, tissues and sandals weighing up to 300 g. In an early demo it took about a minute to lift a pair of socks.
quip: The sock problem, solved at roughly one sock every thirty seconds.
cost: $1,999 in the US and £1,800 in the UK at launch, per Stuff
